description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Font, which represents a font object used for rendering text in the Image_Graph library. It includes methods for setting font properties such as name, size, color, and angle, and extends the common functionalities from Image_Graph_Common.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Font
classes.description: A class representing font properties for graphical text rendering, capable of setting font attributes such as name, size, color, and angle.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Font
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing the font object with optional name and size.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the font.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the angle at which the font will be rendered.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the font.

methods.name: _getFont
methods.description: Returns an array describing the font properties suitable for passing to the rendering canvas.
